summary: Tested scheduler quiet hours gate in _process_pending_campaign_sends(). All 10 unit tests pass covering: 2 AM deferral, 10 AM no-deferral, 8 AM / 9 PM boundaries, evening deferral to next day, default timezone fallback (America/Denver), deferred_reason format, and custom timezone (America/New_York).
critical_code_review_comments: Quiet hours only applies when delivery_mode in ('automated', 'auto') — manual sends bypass the gate, which appears intentional.

The quiet hours check silently swallows exceptions via a broad except block (logger.debug only). If ZoneInfo fails for an unknown tz_name, the send would proceed without deferral. Consider stricter error handling or fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiet hours gate is in scheduler.py lines 731-758. Logic: if delivery_mode in (automated, auto) AND (hour < 8 OR hour >= 21 local time), defer to 9 AM same day (if early AM) or 9 AM next day (if evening). Timezone from users.timezone field, defaults to America/Denver. deferred_reason set to 'quiet hours (was H:00 local)'. Frontend date separator not tested (UI-only change).
